files.README.md:
# Silverbank Haulage - trunk legs

Shared folder for the traffic office.

- runs/  cards for each leg and trip
- fuel/  bunker notes from the depot

turns.prompt: A traffic planner at Silverbank Haulage is working out what a trunk trip is worth; a tonne-kilometre is one tonne carried one kilometre, and a leg run empty carries no payload. Trip TR-88 runs 132 kilometres out and 132 kilometres back empty, carrying 22.5 tonnes on the loaded leg only. Give the work the trip did, as a single number in tonne-kilometres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
